additionalDocuments.label: Ellington Riverton House official project brief

review.gallery: Nine native images from Ellington’s official Riverton House brochure. First image and listing depict the same lagoon-facing tower.
review.location: Official project brief pages 8 and 9 provide eleven timed destinations and the marked site illustration. JRE publishes a development vicinity coordinate. The 12- and 14-minute racecourse estimates remain visible as a range. The source labels the metro route as proposed.
review.floorPlans: 18 complete sheets: ten apartments, two retail units, four typical plates and two amenity levels. Checked the printed areas and physical page indexes. Typical plates label the study units +S, matching the detailed plan titles.

unavailable: The exact visitor entrance, standalone parking plans and signed unit-specific area schedules were not established.
